assets.prompt: Redesign the reference as a 16:9 hand-drawn 2D anime game background specifically for the Katsumeshi Game SHOP screen. Keep the lower center as clear wood floor. Clearly hand-inked flat 2D cel-shaded illustration with bold clean outlines, simplified shapes, matte colors and limited soft painterly texture; it must look illustrated, not 3D or photographic. Medium-low contrast behind UI. No people, characters, food, plates, readable text, menu writing, logos, UI, watermark, frame, white margins or collage.
